run_embedding_sync: run a synchronous embedding call against an OpenAI-like endpoint with model, input, and optional parameters
run_embedding_async: run an async embedding call against an OpenAI-like endpoint using an async HTTP client
build_embedding_handler: build an OpenAI-like embedding handler that supports custom api_base, api_key, and headers
test_embedding_handler: test the OpenAILikeEmbeddingHandler class for sync and async embedding calls
review_embedding_handler: review the OpenAILikeEmbeddingHandler class and its error handling for httpx status and timeout errors
